rank_definition: 1 plus the number of strictly higher scores; ties share rank.

definitions.clean_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows cut at this seed, replayed over 100–999.
definitions.band_seeds: All 250 uploaded rows return HDR at this seed, replayed over 100–999.
definitions.candidate_window: Historical 150-seed circular slice of predicted 300 seeds (h0–h5, stride 50) or complementary 600 seeds (h6–h9, stride 150).
